lines.text: Dear Sysop. I'm Lee. I'm sixty-one.
I'm learning to code with agents. I pick a Tape, and a Drive does the work.
Here is the first bug it fixed. Your friend, Lee.
Dear Sysop. Please write a letter to my boss.
Twelve Drives at once. Atlas memory. And Atlas agents that hand my agents work.
How much will all this cost?
Make it official, okay? Sincerely, Pat.
Dear Sysop. Could you make a computer I can just talk to? Sincerely, Jo.
Dear Sysop. Outfitter rules the fleet. Your Outfitter friend, M G M.
Twelve Drives at once. Atlas memory. And Atlas agents that hand my agents work!
